entries.not_wired: no OpenTelemetry reader (not required by the plan row); the local offered-load workflow (`xtask benchmarks offered-load`, wrk2, loopback only) has not been run here because wrk2 is not installed (it reports BlockedResource), and there is no exact installed-production acceptance; not worker-routed (HighRisk manual/offline behind HIGH_RISK_APPLY_IMPLEMENTED=false); socket options and qdisc replacement are deliberately not operations: `net_capability` gives the read-only congestion-control and qdisc inventory and typed refusals that state why (a socket option needs the owning descriptor; replacing a root qdisc cannot be restored exactly); Prometheus import and compare-load remain read-only
entries.unblock: HTTP/RPC/network physical proof requires an owned local disposable service, versioned benchmark tools (iperf3, wrk, wrk2, h2load are absent here), fixed offered load and direct latency/error/completion guards; the CPU fixed-work transport evidence is not a network qualification, and bpftune is absent so no cooperative strategy was exercised

entries.g0: frozen manifest, paired statistics, supervised run engine, a verified artifact manifest and a hyperfine JSON importer (samples, exit codes); sysbench, stress-ng, benchstat and Phoronix importers produce typed scores that are constant application_proof=false (`xtask benchmarks import-scores`); malformed input is an error

entries.g0: a typed cross-boot campaign (`CrossBootCampaign` with `compare_boots`) keys every block by the boot environment identity, so kernel variants are analysed separately; RT, Zen, Liquorix and CachyOS kernels are not available as reproducible specialisations on this host (HardwareUnavailable), so no run on them happened; persistent validation runner with 6.12 and 7.2 specialisations exists; BootEnvironment now fingerprints kernel, preemption model, isolation and generation
entries.g1: earlier multi-kernel resume evidence is retained
entries.unblock: Needs on the host: RT, Zen, Liquorix and CachyOS kernel specialisations

entries.g0: `compare_boots` names exactly what differs between two boots (kernel, preemption, each isolation key, microcode, sched_ext, command line; a generation-only change is reported but still comparable) and `CrossBootCampaign` groups blocks by context hash so blocks from different kernels are never pooled, refuses a repeated block, and survives a reboot as a JSON file; the context hash without the generation is also part of the candidate-memory key; typed boot environment: kernel release, preemption model from the version string, parsed nohz_full/rcu_nocbs/isolcpus/irqaffinity CPU lists, microcode, generation, sched_ext ops, command-line hash (never the raw line), environment hash that ignores the boot id; housekeeping CPUs; reported by doctor
entries.g1: read on this host (kernel 6.18.57, PREEMPT_DYNAMIC, no isolation)

entries.g0: versioned `experimental-1` KPI contract templates for low-latency audio (deadline misses with server xruns as a hard guardrail) and browser/desktop interactivity (input-to-response p95 with long tasks as a hard guardrail) are bound to one live process (`stutter kpi-serve --template audio-xrun|browser-response --pid`), reported by the application over the confined kernel-authenticated socket, never derived from CPU use, never authorizing an operation; the thresholds are declared, not calibrated, and positive/neutral/harmful campaigns on a real audio or browser workload are EvidenceDeferred. fixed-work compile objective is Supported; audio, browser and desktop direct sources are not built
